snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The greatest temptation is trying to control something we do not fully understand. But what do we do when faced with truly inexplicable? 
Do we run, consumed by fear, or step forward, driven by curiosity and defiance? In the Zone, every answer comes at a cost, and the truth may be the greatest price of all.
Heart of Chornobyl is finally calling you, stalkers.
